articles.summary: Rinsed, the Car Wash CRM, is announcing its integration with DRB Patheon, a leading point-of-sale system for the car wash industry.
articles.title: Rinsed Completes Integration with DRB® Patheon®

articles.summary: Rinsed announced the release of its Q2 2024 Car Wash Industry Report. This report analyzes data from over 2,000 car washes, allowing operators to better understand their wash’s performance.
articles.title: Rinsed Releases Q2 2024 Car Wash Industry Report
